data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by the qwen model encountering API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, LICENSE, and libffi-regression.c files, resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict. learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP 400 errors from causing partial audits and inconclusive verdicts.
